study type: Diagnostic accuracy and validation study (using two cohorts)
cohort: The study participants were stillbirths from Maputo Central Hospital, Mozambique, comprising two cohorts: CaDMIA-Plus (n=90; 2017-2018) and MIBio (n=98; 2021-2022).
finding: c-MITS showed almost perfect agreement with CA for determining CoD in stillbirths (Kappa=0.82), and a simplified s-MITS protocol (using lung and placenta samples) achieved substantial agreement (Kappa=0.79) while reducing costs by 55.7%.
